change: Classroom ad-revenue model: lib/class-monetization.js and GET /api/admin/class-monetization, the per-class funnel from enrolled through to estimated ad revenue
_context: WHY THERE IS NO live CHECK, and the reasoning is the one from
docs/runs/2026-09-18-claude-code-frq-archive-imported-and-gate-phase.md
rather than a shortcut.
This change DOES alter what the API serves: it adds an endpoint. So a sha
pin looks correct here in a way it did not for that tooling change. It is
still the wrong check, for a different reason.
The new endpoint sits under /api/admin/*, where router.use(requireAdmin)
runs BEFORE any route matching. So an unauthenticated request to a path
that does not exist and one to a path that does both answer
403 Invalid or missing admin key. Measured against production on
2026-09-19, before the merge:
GET /api/admin/class-monetization   ->   403   already
The assertion first written for this gate was that the 404 becomes a 403.
It would have passed the day before the change existed, which is the exact
decoration CLAUDE.md warns about, and running it BEFORE the deploy is the
only reason that was caught.
The endpoint is therefore not observable from a session holding only
COMMAND_READ_TOKEN and TODO_KEY, and that is the fail-closed design working
rather than a gap to route around. A sha pin in its place would be a dated
receipt: true for as long as it takes the next pull request to merge, then
permanently red on a change that was fine.
rederive is the honest kind here, and it does not expire. A session holding
the admin key can add the live check afterwards; the assertion worth making
is that the response carries a stage, a calibration basis and at least one
null where a reading is missing.
WHAT THE MUTATIONS DEFEND. Every one of them is a way this model could
produce a confident, plausible, wrong number that a person would then price
a product against. The first is the one the whole module exists for: a
class with no RPM reading rendering as $0 of ads inverts the argument for
charging money for an ad-free room.
THE rederive CHECK HAS ALREADY EARNED ITS PLACE. It disagreed with the
module on 2 of 24 generated classes by a cent, because the module priced
off an unrounded annual pageview count while reporting the rounded one. It
only shows on small classes and the hand-written fixture, which uses round
numbers, could not see it at all.
